title: Pal Pal Mai Roti Rahi Baba
body:
baba mere baba ...(4)
zindaan me jab sakina ko baba ka sar mila
roksaar rak ke chahraye sarwar pe ye kaha
my kaise bataaoon jo guzari yahan
are rodaad sunlo meri babajaan
pal pal my roti rahi baba har pal my roti rahi baba....(2)
baba mujhe neend aathi nahi aur my kahi chain pathi anhi...(2)
my har dum tadap thi rahi baba har pal my marthi rahi baba
pal pal my roti rahi baba har pal my roti rahi baba....(2)
ammo gaye jab se aye baba jan ayena phir loutkar ke yahan...(2)
my awaaz dethi rahi baba har pal my marthi rahi baba
pal pal my roti rahi baba har pal my roti rahi baba....(2)
rahaa ne hum waaro pur khaar me phuppiyon ke hamraha bazaar me..(2)
my tash heer hothi rahi baba har pal my marthi rahi baba
pal pal my roti rahi baba har pal my roti rahi baba....(2)
hawa ka guzar bhi nahi hai yahan hai hone ko ab munkhatha meri jan..(2)
my zindaan me ghut thi rahi baba har pal my marthi rahi baba
pal pal my roti rahi baba har pal my roti rahi baba....(2)
mujhe pushthe naaqa se baanda gaya mujhe har khadam par sathaya gaya..(2)
my dukh dard sehthi rahi baba har pal my marthi rahi baba
pal pal my roti rahi baba har pal my roti rahi baba....(2)
zameen garm hothi rahi dhoop se dehekthi thi rahen kadi dhoop se..(2)
my uspar bhi chalthi rahi baba har pal my marthi rahi baba
pal pal my roti rahi baba har pal my roti rahi baba....(2)
zalim ne maare tamaache mujhe abhi tak hai roksaar nile mere..(2)
ye sab zulm sehthi rahi baba har pal my marthi rahi baba
pal pal my roti rahi baba har pal my roti rahi baba....(2)
my gairon ke majme me layi gayi my be makhna chadar phirayi gayi..(2)
my dardar batakthi rahi baba har pal my marthi rahi baba
pal pal my roti rahi baba har pal my roti rahi baba....(2)
gayi jab bhi naize pe meri nazar mere dil pe ghum ka huwa ye asar ..(2)
meri saans rukthi rahi baba har pal my marthi rahi baba
pal pal my roti rahi baba har pal my roti rahi baba....(2)
kiya joun ne jo ye noha rakham huwe chashme rehan ashko se nam...(2)
sakina jo kehthi rahi baba har pal my marthi rahi baba
pal pal my roti rahi baba har pal my roti rahi baba....(2)
baba mere baba ..(2)
